description:
This file defines a React functional component named ViewDetailsModal that renders a modal dialog displaying detailed information about a JSON data object. It includes utility functions for formatting labels, currency values, and handling special display cases for user costs. The component utilizes React hooks, TypeScript types, and external components.

The purpose of the component is to provide a generic, reusable UI widget for viewing details of arbitrary data objects within an application.

methods.name: ViewDetailsModal
methods.description: React functional component that renders a modal showing details of a JSON object. It formats labels and values, handles special cases for cost data, and displays the data in a styled list.
